references.title: Live: Client Network Chips + Script Accent Caption

observed.description: Real talking-head frame: young man in a grey tee against a dark wood-slat wall, with a broadcast mic on a boom arm. observed.typography: Caption sans is SF Pro/Inter Semibold, white, ~3.2% of frame height. The accent is an elegant italic script serif (cream #F3E6C4) ~2x size, overlapping the sans line. UI text is tiny Inter: medium titles, regular grey sublines.
observed.composition: Face kept fully clear in the top 45%. The caption sits just below the chin (~50%). UI occupies the 58-80% band on the right half, over the shirt and mic arm, and the 'You' node sits left. Elements are ~40% of frame width. A small brand logo is bottom-left.
observed.lighting_effects: UI chips are dark charcoal (#1B1C20 at ~85%) with a 1px light border and a soft drop shadow. The footage's lower area is naturally dark, which the UI sits into. No blur of the speaker.

inferred.animation: INFERRED: the chips pop in staggered top to bottom (each 60-80ms apart, y+12px->0, opacity, scale .96->1, 250ms ease-out). The dotted connector then draws from 'You' to the active chip. The caption builds word by word, with 'clients' arriving in script on the stressed word. Everything exits together with a quick fade/slide down.
inferred.use_cases: Explaining relationships, inbound clients, network or audience. A visual proof of a claim while the speaker keeps eye contact.
inferred.recreation: See templates/live-ui-list.html. Chip: 220-280px wide at 1080w, radius 12, padding 10/12, bg rgba(24,25,30,.86), border 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08), shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45). Avatar square 22px radius 6 #2A2B30. Dotted line: SVG stroke-dasharray 2 4, stroke #9AA0AA, with a blue dot head #3B82F6.
